The '''Republic Hyperspace Armada''' was a [[Fleet/Legends|armada]] which was founded by [[Sodoh Reddik]], an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] who fought in the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. It fought the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].
